verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no Jan-published SDK in any language. What it does document is an OpenAI-compatible local REST API, plus a note that third-party Anthropic and OpenAI SDK clients can be pointed at it. That is API compatibility with other vendors' SDKs, an adjacent capability that earns no credit toward Jan shipping its own official SDKs. No OpenAPI spec was found either, so there is no basis for generated client libraries.
